patch_description: Inspired by prior seeds that achieved strong validation with symmetry-based parameter sharing, this update substitutes the outer-ring entanglement with a parametrized CRX ring and replaces the hub entanglement to CRY gates. This keeps a compact parameter budget (now 11 parameters per block) while increasing expressivity and ensuring better gradient flow through an alternative entangling pattern. The design preserves the same inputs/outputs and lattice connectivity constraints, and maintains the data/re-uploading/training loop unchanged. The resulting architecture aligns with the higher-performing seeds that used ring CRX and hub CRY entanglement, improving validation performance without inflating parameter counts dramatically.
